summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialised in the constructor, recorded and cleared in run(), and a new tests/test_concurrency.py (7 tests, all passing over five repeated runs). Nothing committed. Caveats: tests were run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src because the shared venv resolves textual to another checkout; the wider suite shows 68 failures that are identical on untouched HEAD (missing pytest-asyncio in the venv); a call racing app shutdown can still block on future.result().
